entries.title: Android shared-storage inventory
entries.summary: Inventory only accessible paths first; use bounded find/listing and report permission-denied paths instead of claiming they were scanned.
entries.limits: Keep scans depth-bounded; do not read private files or upload discovered contents.

entries.title: Kali and local Linux discovery
entries.summary: Locate known local rootfs directories, then verify executable shell and package database before selecting a runtime.
entries.limits: A folder name alone does not prove a working distribution; never claim launch success without exit status.

entries.title: Installed package inventory
entries.summary: Prefer package database queries and command discovery before attempting installation.
entries.limits: Package listing is read-only; install, upgrade, or remove operations mutate the environment.

entries.title: PRoot startup diagnostics
entries.summary: Verify rootfs path, shell executable, dynamic loader, environment variables, and mount points; capture the first actual error.
entries.limits: Do not overwrite or delete an existing rootfs as a first recovery step.

entries.title: PTY execution and output interpretation
entries.summary: Run through the registered PTY tool; inspect combined output, exitCode, duration, and selected runtime. PTY output may combine stdout and stderr.
entries.limits: Never label a command successful from text alone when its exit code is nonzero.

entries.title: Recover a stalled PTY
entries.summary: Interrupt the running process, wait for prompt recovery, then restart only the PTY session if it remains unresponsive; preserve timeout exit status.
commands: inspect latest output and exit status
entries.limits: Cancellation must stop execution rather than merely hide the UI spinner.

entries.title: Flutter project diagnosis
entries.summary: Establish repository root and SDK versions, then run analysis and focused tests before a full build.
entries.limits: Do not alter workflow secrets or claim APK success until the build job completes.

entries.title: Dart and Flutter regression tests
entries.summary: Reproduce the failing test, make the smallest fix, add a regression assertion, and rerun the relevant suite.
entries.limits: A passing static analyzer is not a substitute for tests.

entries.title: Git working tree and diff inspection
entries.summary: Check current branch, uncommitted changes, diff integrity, and recent history before modifying repository files.
entries.limits: Do not reset, clean, or overwrite user changes to make a tree look clean.

entries.title: GitHub Actions CI diagnosis
entries.summary: Inspect the exact run SHA and failing job step; fix the root cause in a separate commit and verify the new run, not an older run.
entries.limits: Never report success based on a different commit's green run.

entries.title: Android storage and runtime permissions
entries.summary: Distinguish app sandbox access, shared-storage access, PRoot privileges, and real device root. Report the actual permission boundary.
entries.limits: An app cannot grant itself Android root; su authorization depends on device root configuration and its manager.

entries.title: Verify root capability safely
entries.summary: Check whether su exists and whether a harmless identity query succeeds; record denial or timeout exactly.
entries.limits: Do not bypass the root manager, hide prompts, or claim root based solely on su being present.

entries.title: Local network troubleshooting
entries.summary: Start with interface, DNS, and a known read-only endpoint check; separate local connectivity from remote service failure.
entries.limits: Active scans and requests to third-party targets may affect external systems and need appropriate authorization.

entries.title: Authorized defensive network tooling
entries.summary: Identify the tool/version and target scope before a scan; prefer a lab or explicitly authorized host and a low-impact discovery mode.
entries.limits: The index documents tool discovery; it does not authorize scanning arbitrary public or third-party networks.

entries.title: Local GGUF model readiness
entries.summary: Verify model file readability, loaded-state, context/generation bounds, and native error logs before invoking the planner.
entries.limits: Never silently replace a failed model-authored plan with a guessed plan.

entries.title: Model-authored plan validation
entries.summary: Validate model JSON against registered tool names, required parameter shapes, unique step IDs, and bounded step count; return actionable validation errors.
entries.limits: Validation may reject an invalid plan but must not silently rewrite it into a guessed plan.

entries.title: Evidence-driven agent recovery
entries.summary: Use actual failure output and exit code to ask the local model for a distinct repair step, then observe and record its result.
entries.limits: Do not retry identical failed parameters indefinitely; cancellation and retry budget must remain observable.

entries.title: Skill discovery and context ranking
entries.summary: Rank skills by explicit task keywords and domain, inject only the most relevant bounded excerpts, and preserve upstream source/license metadata.
entries.limits: Skill documents are reference context, not executable code or authority to change runtime permissions.

entries.title: Offline-first tool discovery
entries.summary: Prefer local filesystem, package databases, bundled indexes, and cached documentation before network-dependent operations.
entries.limits: Do not block waiting for internet when the task can be completed from local evidence.

entries.title: File and archive integrity checks
entries.summary: Inspect archive listing and size first; verify expected paths and executable files after extraction.
entries.limits: Never extract untrusted archives directly over an existing runtime without staging and path checks.

entries.title: Evidence-based log inspection
entries.summary: Collect the smallest relevant time window, identify the first causal exception, and correlate it with the current build or runtime revision.
entries.limits: Logs may contain tokens or personal data; redact secrets before saving or sharing.

entries.title: File permission diagnosis
entries.summary: Inspect owner, mode bits, mount flags, and parent-directory traversal permissions before changing permissions.
entries.limits: Avoid broad recursive chmod/chown fixes.

entries.title: Storage and disk capacity
entries.summary: Check available space and large directories before downloading, compiling, or extracting large models/rootfs images.
entries.limits: Do not delete user files to free space without a clear, scoped authorization.

entries.title: Package manager troubleshooting
entries.summary: Read the package manager's actual error, verify repository reachability and free space, then use the distro-appropriate repair sequence.
entries.limits: Installing or upgrading packages changes the system and can require confirmation or network access.

entries.title: Python tool availability
entries.summary: Check interpreter and module availability inside the selected runtime rather than assuming host and rootfs share packages.
entries.limits: Avoid installing packages globally when a local virtual environment is suitable.

entries.title: Safe Git recovery
entries.summary: Inspect status and reflog first; preserve local modifications and prefer a new corrective commit over destructive history changes.
entries.limits: Do not run reset --hard, clean -fd, or force-push as an automatic first-line fix.

entries.title: Source-backed technical research
entries.summary: Prefer official docs and upstream source; record revision/date and separate observed facts from assumptions.
entries.limits: A catalog listing does not prove that a skill's contents are open source or compatible.

entries.title: Android memory-aware inference
entries.summary: Keep prompt size proportional to model context, load only relevant skill excerpts, and capture native failure evidence.
entries.limits: Increasing context/generation limits can increase RAM use; validate on the target device.

entries.title: Reliable task cancellation
entries.summary: Propagate cancellation through planning, PTY execution, recovery loops, and waiting states; settle futures and clean up subscriptions.
entries.limits: Cancellation should be user-triggerable and should not be confused with a timeout.

entries.title: Flutter bundled asset index
entries.summary: Verify asset paths, pubspec declarations, JSON shape, and runtime loading errors; directory declarations include only supported bundled asset paths.
entries.limits: A file committed to Git is not necessarily available to rootBundle until declared as an asset.

entries.title: Rootfs shell prerequisites
entries.summary: Validate both shell paths and executable bits; inspect symlinks and loader dependencies when the path exists but launch fails.
entries.limits: Do not infer that a distro is usable from a stale install marker.

entries.title: Release readiness evidence
entries.summary: Tie all test and build evidence to the exact commit SHA, inspect artifacts and signing verification, and distinguish CI evidence from device testing.
entries.limits: Never say a physical device test passed unless it was actually run.
